results.title: Existential Parallelism and Suicidal Desire: A Clinical Framework for Meaning-Ba
results.reason: The paper presents a clinically relevant framework for understanding suicidal desire by integrating existential psychology with social theory, offering novel assessment and intervention approaches for practicing clinicians.

results.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Psychotherapeutic Tool: Competency Delegation, Ethi
results.reason: This paper focuses on artificial intelligence (AI) as a psychotherapeutic tool, examining ethical boundaries and competency delegation. While it touches on psychological practice, the primary emphasis is on technology integration, ethical frameworks, and organizational applications rather than clinical psychology practice, assessment, diagnosis, or therapeutic interventions. The paper falls under the AI/tech category which is explicitly rejected for this clinical psychology hub.
